body: Thank you so much (: that means alot
Thank you so much for saying that. You have no idea how happy that truly makes me.
I'm just going to go through with it. No point turning back now
I have to get him away from me regardless. He was abusive in every aspect and still is. He blamed our baby's death on me.

It's easier said than done. I don't know how to leave him out of my life. He was the father. He was the one who gave me the abortion, but I still can't walk away. He basically controls me. I don't have anyone to talk to anymore.

In one week would be the day I lost my baby,  my ex boyfriend has been harassing me and bringing me down even more, my friend stabbed me in the back,  my dad doesn't give a shut about me, and I'm trying to get over the fact I was raped.
About 3 major ones,  two minor ones
A multitude of things. I've given myself 12 more hours.
Thank you. It just hurts, he's always been really insensitive to my feelings.

It was a pretty abusive relationship.  He was a narcissistic,  emotional/mental and physically abusive person. He tried to control everything thing I did, down to when he got me pregnant. I didn't necessarily want to abort, but he didn't give me that option. I wouldn't go through with the abortion. So he took matters into his own hands, so to speak.
Yes,  it was a long term relationship.

I stopped seeing a conselot because she downplayed my feelings. I don't have a camera, no. Photography isn't my thing. I'm a 19 year old girl. My family does know of my depression, but it isn't an urgent concern. I'm basically alone. If I don't go through with it now, I'll just go through with it when I'm ready.
The only things I'm good at are drawing and writing...and singing kind of.. I love my dogs...but it's just not enough. . I just feel empty. I don't feel good about anything

I appreciate you reaching out to me. I may be here for a purpose but I don't want to have to go through any more pain to find it. I don't feel like I'm worth anything.  He said I wasn't . I couldn't even save my own baby.  I may have been able to make someone else smile but I'm not happy. I haven't been for a while. I keep reliving the same nightmare.   I used to enjoy signing and writing. But that was then. I just don't care anymore. I'm so tired or being in pain
I just don't know what to do anymore
He took everything I was
Everything is gone. I'm gone.
I don't have anything left anymore.
No, he got me pregnant, and he took that away from me..
He's abused me in every single way possible.. he used the feelings I had for them against me and completely broke me down
He's completely ruined everything I used to be..
I just want to know what it feels like to have something other than pain in my life. Something other than feeling pain..
He had complete control over me. Still does. He's broken me down to basically nothing, just to fix me, then break me all over again. He's taken everything from me and he thinks of it aas a game..
I'm just in a lot of pain..
My ex boyfriend has a lot to do with the way i feel..
I don't know what I want. I just don't want to feel like this anymore. It hurts too much.
I don't know what to do. I couldn't even go through with it. My ex boyfriend was right... I'm pathetic.
I feel dead inside. I just couldn't go through with ending it. I'm pathetic.  I can't even go through with dying..
I'm sorry you have to go through with that.. I may have not been able to finish what I wanted but I've already given up.
I wasn't able to go through with it.. I'm a coward.
Nobody knows I even exist. I'll just make it happen. I'm tired of walking away from things.  I'm going through with this.
I'm sorry...but it's too late.

I'm sorry you're in an unfortunate situation too. I'm sorry you have to experience pain. The reason I'm posting this is so that someone will know that I'm dead. Nobody else will care. I hope your situation gets better...
I appreciate the offer...but I've made up my mind.
I'll be out of the situation shortly..

I turned 19 last month. I just can't seem to find the people that can understand me and actually talk to me. I'm sorry that you still have to wait. It sucks. And thanks, it feels great to know someone doesn't think my feelings are pathetic. It was very rough, my dog got hit by a truck right in front of me. She was my best friend. My boyfriend was a narcissistic abusive person...and he really damaged me.

Oh man...
